title.description: The problem in at most 10 words.

severity.description: high: left alone, the proposal misses its goal, breaks something, or loses data. medium: real cost or risk, but the goal is still reached. low: a minor improvement.

challenges_settled_decision.description: True when this point argues against a decision listed under Settled decisions in the brief.

claim.description: What is wrong with the proposal and why it matters, in plain words.

evidence.description: File paths with line numbers you read, or quotes from the brief, that show the problem is real.

suggested_change.description: The concrete change to the proposal that would fix it.
